info.cls_ename: Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch: 中英筆譯入門課程。除介紹筆譯原則、手法、技巧等，並透過中英互譯反覆演練，由句子開始進行到段落的翻譯，訓練學生分析譯入語和譯出語以及掌握中英文讀寫的技巧，培養學生未來在就業市場上具備基本筆譯的能力。
description.describe_eh: This course is designed to introduce to students English-Chinese translation principles, approaches and techniques. Through repeated English-Chinese translation exercises beginning with sentences and progressing to paragraphs, students are trained to analyze source and target texts and to master reading and writing skills in both languages. It also aims to assist students in developing the competence to translate in the workplace.

gradeRules.evalb_memo: Quizzes, assignments, active participation and attendance

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. Participation/Quizzes/Assignments/Attendance 45%;
2. Written Midterm Exam 25%;
3. Final exam--CDIO Project: Journalistic translation and editing an e-newspaper 30%
 
* A volunteer will get 0.45 extra point each time he/she volunteers, with the maximum of a total of 8 points per semester towards the final score.
**Please be punctual. Students who are over 15 minutes late will be considered absent from the class of the day. Moreover, students who are absent for more than 5 (including 5) class meetings (= 10 hours) will fail the course without further notice.
*** Most assignments will be done in class. As for homework exercise/presentation submissions, a 3-day grace period will be given. After the grace period, no late assignments will be accepted.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂規則
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. No use of mobile phones unless instructed otherwise. 除非課堂需要及老師允許，上課禁用手機。
4. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
5. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
6. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。
7. Short quizzes are not to be made up. Long quizzes can be made up only when you have a valid reason and/or communicate it with the teacher in advance. Valid reasons include documented illness, death in the immediate family, participation in a conference, (car) accidents, etc. The instructor reserves the right to judge whether the absence is valid or not. 短測驗不得補考。若您有正當理由請假，或事先與老師溝通提出申請得准予補考長測驗。正當理由包括：有證明之疾病、直系親屬死亡、參加會議、車禍意外等等。
8.  Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late applications for make-ups will receive a ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若補考當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
9. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams, and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: The course Final is a CDIO team project--journalistic translation and editing an e-newspaper  (30%). Please see Course Syllabus and Course Documents for more details.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
綜合說明
  1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data. AI-generative tools are forbidden to translate assignments unless the instructor permits them for discussion purposes. 學生在學術活動中必須展現誠實和道德行為，避免抄襲和篡改資料。除非教師允許為進行討論之用，禁止用AI生成工具翻譯作業。
  2. Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.抄襲：必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
  3. Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
